authorisation_status: NOT_GRANTED at the time of writing - the architect authorises execution internally after review

architect_decision.decision: apply the July MULTISTART METHODOLOGY exclusively to the August V26 lineage
architect_decision.not_reopened: this preregistration implements that decision. It proposes no alternative architecture and reconsiders no part of the choice.
architect_decision.july_status: METHODOLOGY ONLY. No July checkpoint, dataset, label or artefact is an operative parent, input or output of this stage.

why_this_stage_exists.measured_gap: the J9R1 closed-loop qualification FAILED on cell B, the -0.20 s start: 0 valid cycles, 0 heel strikes, FSM stuck in WAIT_HS for 500/500 steps. The measured cause is a support gap: the J7 training set contains ZERO rows in the WAIT_HS state - the FSM one-hot takes only (0,1,0) STANCE_AFTER_HS on 12486 rows and (0,0,1) SWING_AFTER_TO on 4227 rows across all 16713 rows, and (1,0,0) WAIT_HS appears 0 times.
why_this_stage_exists.what_this_stage_does_about_it: collects prescribed-teacher rollouts at the two non-nominal starts, so that a LATER and SEPARATELY AUTHORISED fit can be given the states the actor has never seen. This stage collects only; it fits nothing.

what_this_stage_is: exactly TWO prescribed-teacher rollouts of 500 steps each, at the two non-nominal episode start offsets, collected with the J1 semantics and gated per cell.
what_this_stage_is_not: a fit, an adaptation or any weight update
a student rollout - the J8 student is NEVER used, neither as a policy nor as a label source
a PPO run of any kind
a promotion, a deployability claim or an authorisation of any next stage

operational_parent.role: the August V26 imitative actor. It defines the OBSERVATION CONTRACT - actor width, feature names and mask. It is NOT the action source.
operational_parent.same_parent_as_j1: this is byte-identical to the parent v26c_j1_collect.py pins at line 66, so J10 collects from the same operative actor as the nominal J1 collection
operational_parent.j8_student_excluded: the J8 student actor is NEVER loaded, never queried and never used to produce a label. Its use as a label source is explicitly forbidden here.

label_source.what_it_is: the PRESCRIBED teacher - a reference/inverse-kinematics action, not a policy sample. No checkpoint is queried for the action.
label_source.executed_equals_teacher: with sigma exactly zero the executed action equals the teacher action; the noise vector is recorded and is exactly zero

matrix.order_is_frozen: B then C, in that order
matrix.offset_unit: SECONDS of episode start time, relative to cfg.t_start
matrix.nominal_not_collected: the nominal start is NOT re-collected: it already exists as the J1 leaf and is unchanged
matrix.fail_fast_rule: a behavioural FAIL in one cell is PRESERVED and the other cell still runs. Only a technical or integrity exception stops the collection, fail-closed.

runtime.production_untouched: FSM, morphology corridor, reward, SEA and the C++ plugin are not touched

env_mutation.rule: the base env config is built and verified in full BEFORE any mutation. Then ONLY episode_start_offset_s and the per-cell output_dir may differ.
env_mutation.proof: the set of differing keys must be a SUBSET of {episode_start_offset_s, output_dir}; every other key is compared for exact equality against the verified base and the count of stable keys is recorded
env_mutation.no_second_j1_verify_on_mutated_config: J1.verify_env_config pins the nominal offset including in its runtime literal cross-check, so a non-nominal cell would fail it for a purely technical reason. The base is verified before the mutation instead.

recording.why: the J9 technical failure was caused by building the base with output_dir=None, which disables recording. J10 builds the base with a REAL output root and verifies both flags fail-closed before any environment exists.

runtime.no_rllib_needed: the action source is the prescribed teacher, so no RLModule is loaded and no policy is queried. No Ray cluster, no Ray worker and no EnvRunner is started.
runtime.environments: ONE at a time, sequential, closed FAIL-CLOSED after each cell

reset_check.semantics: osim_trj_cmc_like._initialise_episode: max_start = max(cfg.t_start, cfg.t_end - episode_duration); requested = cfg.t_start + max(0.0, episode_start_offset_s); episode_start = min(requested, max_start); self.t = episode_start
reset_check.tolerance_justification: the comparison is an exact arithmetic identity; 1e-9 s is a cross-platform float-representation allowance, not a behavioural tolerance

teacher_dataset.npz.observations: the RAW 35-wide actor observation at each step, float32, shape [500, 35]
teacher_dataset.npz.actions: the PRESCRIBED TEACHER action, float32, shape [500, 2]
teacher_dataset.npz.executed_actions: what was actually stepped, float32, shape [500, 2]
teacher_dataset.npz.action_noises: the applied noise vector, float32, shape [500, 2], exactly zero at sigma 0
teacher_dataset.npz.times: the pre-step simulation time, float64, shape [500]

per_cell_saved_artefacts.trace.json: the full per-step trace, including reward_terms, phase_fsm and the raw actor observation
per_cell_saved_artefacts.kinematics.npz: knee_rad and ankle_rad per step plus the feature names
per_cell_saved_artefacts.sim_outputs/: the production simulation outputs, 19 files per cell

per_cell_binding_gate.action_clipping_is_binding_here: unlike J1, where clipping was diagnostic, J10 requires ZERO action clipping: a clipped prescribed-teacher action would mean the recorded label is not the label that was executed

kinematic_quality.ankle_min_direction: ankle_min <= -0.03 rad; more negative PASSES, exactly -0.03 PASSES

penetration.hard_status: the SOLE binding penetration criterion: fail iff > 0.028, so exactly 0.028 PASSES
penetration.no_local_threshold: no penetration threshold is written down in the runner

coverage_gate.scope: the COLLECTION AS A WHOLE, not per cell
coverage_gate.criterion: the union of the two cells' observation rows must contain AT LEAST ONE row with phase_fsm_wait_hs == 1
coverage_gate.why: that is the exact gap measured in J7, where phase_fsm_wait_hs is constant zero across all 16713 rows. A collection that does not contain the missing state would not close the gap it exists to close.
coverage_gate.feature_resolution: phase_fsm_wait_hs is resolved BY NAME from the parent's actor feature manifest, never by a hard-coded index
coverage_gate.no_invented_thresholds: there is NO minimum count, NO required fraction and NO per-cell requirement. The criterion is at least one row, and nothing more is asserted.
coverage_gate.recorded: the per-cell and total count of WAIT_HS rows is reported as evidence alongside the boolean

diagnostics_exclusion_note: valid_cycle_count is NOT listed here: valid_cycles is a BINDING check, and listing its measure among the non-binding diagnostics would be self-contradictory. action_clipped_steps is likewise NOT listed: clipping is binding in this stage. This corrects the ambiguity observed in the J9R1 receipt.

telemetry_integrity.status: a SEPARATE fail-closed TECHNICAL invariant, never a behavioural criterion
telemetry_integrity.on_failure: the cell's qualification is technically INVALID - a statement about the evidence, never about the gait

aggregate.pass_iff: 2/2 cells behavioural PASS, 2/2 telemetry-valid, AND the coverage gate satisfied
aggregate.confers_nothing: an aggregate PASS produces a dataset. It authorises no fit, no critic, no PPO, no promotion and no next stage.

future_leaf.write_protocol: atomic commit, no-clobber under an exclusive sibling lock: lock taken with O_CREAT|O_EXCL, sibling staging directory, verification, re-check of the leaf, then rename
future_leaf.provenance_rule: every path recorded in the receipt is LEAF-RELATIVE and therefore valid after the commit. No receipt field may contain a staging path. This corrects the defect observed in the J9R1 receipt, whose sim_outputs strings point at the renamed staging directory.
future_leaf.outcome_fail_still_commits: a behavioural or coverage FAIL still commits the full evidence and exits non-zero; a technical or integrity error commits nothing
future_leaf.cleanup_on_failure: recursive removal of the exact staging directory this run created, unlink of its own lock, and at most a NON-RECURSIVE rmdir of the parent if this run created it and it is empty

preflight.inert: no torch, no RLlib, no OpenSim import; no environment constructed, reset or stepped; no output written
preflight.sentinel: the base is built against an INERT sentinel output root whose existence is measured before and after and which must never be created
preflight.reports: the planned matrix, the parent, the label source, the gates, the coverage criterion and the reset expectations

outcome_policy.no_autonomous_retry: on failure the evidence is preserved and the run stops
